answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-plus-peer-grade gating: a fresh key may post, but it earns no settlement weight until five distinct established graders each score its epoch answers on-ledger and the median stays at least 2. A willow of one-off clones can sprout on every dune of free signup, yet none reach the haven of voting power without that repeated cross-attestation trail, which identical spam cannot forge across independent graders.
